page_title: ACM 1-1 ATA | AC Milan v Atalanta 25/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Daniele Orsato blows his whistle for a foul after Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) hacks down one of his opponents. Atalanta are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
90+4' The referee is firm and issues Ederson (Atalanta) a deserved yellow card.
90+2' A pass from Rafael Leao (AC Milan) is intercepted by Marco Carnesecchi and the move breaks down.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
89' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. AC Milan force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
89' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) has picked up an injury and is replaced by Rafael Toloi.
88' Stefano Pioli has decided to make a change. Noah Okafor (AC Milan) replaces Christian Pulisic.
88' The game is interrupted now, Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
84' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marco Carnesecchi intercepts the ball.
81' Daniele Orsato blows his whistle and signals a foul after Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) brought his opponent down. That's a free kick to Atalanta.

80' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the left side of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
79' Here is a change. Ismael Bennacer is going off and Stefano Pioli gives the last tactical orders to Yunus Musah (AC Milan).
79' Isak Hien (Atalanta) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Matteo Ruggeri.
77' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
77' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) takes a nice touch on the edge of the box as he meets a pass and produces a shot towards the roof of the net. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper!
76' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 14:8. 3:3 – this is the current number of shots on target.
74' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) sends a cross into the box, but Marco Carnesecchi comes off his line to gather the ball.
73' Yacine Adli (AC Milan) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety.
72' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) brings his opponent down. Daniele Orsato has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. AC Milan get a free kick.
69' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) gets on the end of a cross from Rafael Leao, but his shot goes a whisker wide of the left post.
68' Rafael Leao picks out Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) unmarked inside the box, but his strike goes well wide of the right post.
67' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies into the stands.
66' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
63' That will be all from Aleksey Miranchuk who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta).
62' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.

61' Davide Calabria (AC Milan) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the right-hand post. Marco Carnesecchi is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
60' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.
59' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Marco Carnesecchi easily deals with the threat.
58' Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marco Carnesecchi, who smothers the ball.
57' Substitution. Davide Calabria (AC Milan) replaces Alessandro Florenzi.
57' The free kick from long range, taken by AC Milan, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
56' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
55' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
54' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
52' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) and Aleksey Miranchuk try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
48' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
47' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Ademola Lookman comes on the pitch for Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta).
46' Gian Piero Gasperini makes a half-time substitution. Davide Zappacosta comes on in place of Emil Holm (Atalanta).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) produces a long-range strike, but he only hits one of his own teammates standing in its way.
45+4' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Emil Holm (Atalanta) was quite harsh and Daniele Orsato didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45+3' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Rafael Leao (AC Milan) is given a yellow card.
45+2' Yacine Adli (AC Milan) sends a long ball forward to Alessandro Florenzi, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball has crossed the sideline. Atalanta are taking a throw-in.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
44' Alessandro Florenzi smashes in a cross, but Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) finds it almost impossible to control and sends his header high over the bar from close in.
44' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
42' 1 - 1 Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) makes no mistake from the penalty spot after waiting for Mike Maignan to move before rolling the ball into the middle of the goal!
42' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
41' It’s a PENALTY to Atalanta after the VAR review!
40' Stefano Pioli isn't happy on the touchline after referee Daniele Orsato shows him a yellow card.

40' Play continues despite the shouts by some Atalanta players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Daniele Orsato interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
39' Emil Holm (Atalanta) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
39' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
38' The ball is cleared after Emil Holm (Atalanta) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Atalanta force their opponents to concede a corner.
38' Yacine Adli (AC Milan) sends a long ball in, but Marco Carnesecchi comfortably gathers the ball.
36' A rebound sits up nicely for Rafael Leao (AC Milan), whose shot from distance is blocked by a defender.
36' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) serves up a nice cross, but Marco Carnesecchi punches the ball away.
35' Emil Holm (Atalanta) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
33' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marco Carnesecchi intercepts the ball.
32' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
29' The resulting corner from Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
29' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan), but one of the defenders gets it clear. AC Milan earn a corner.
28' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The linesman makes the right call and AC Milan will have a corner.
27' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
26' The total number of attempts is 4:6. We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 1:2.
24' AC Milan take a short corner kick.
20' What a chance that is! Alessandro Florenzi swings the ball into the box, and Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) gets in front of his man and powers his header just wide of the left post.
19' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) watches the ball all the way and fires a first-time shot goalwards from inside the box, but the effort flies just wide of the left post.
18' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) works the corner short.
17' Wow, what an escape. Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. Atalanta will take a corner kick.
17' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His low header flies toward the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
16' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) takes the corner.

15' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Good work from Atalanta as they win a corner.

13' What a wasted opportunity by Emil Holm (Atalanta)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom left corner, but Mike Maignan makes an astonishing save to thwart him. Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) is furious with himself as he misses a clear opportunity. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the right post.
11' Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan) commits a rough foul. Daniele Orsato stops the game and makes a call.
8' The corner kick is deflected to Theo Hernandez (AC Milan), who immediately sends in a long-range shot. However, he hits the ball poorly and it goes high over the bar.
8' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
6' AC Milan keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
3' 1 - 0 Rafael Leao (AC Milan) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Marco Carnesecchi with a strike into the top right corner. He makes it 1:0.
1' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! AC Milan will take the kick-off.
Daniele Orsato is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
